family.note: family masks have no CRF; `native` is complete FoRIS with CRF; best_in_sample is optimistic

foris.pre.note: levels of the FoRIS response scaled per image; FoRIS cuts at 0.5; a level is worth including when its value is positive

insid3.final.note: levels of the INSID3 aggregate; INSID3 cuts at 0.2; a level is worth including when its value is positive

model.raw_nn.note: levels of half the nearest-token margin plus one half; the origin cuts at 0.5; a level is worth including when its value is positive
